#### Trellix ePO On-Premises

**Event**

This dashboard gives visibility into the event data stream of Trellix ePO On-Premises, showing security and threat activity reported by ePolicy Orchestrator. It highlights total events with unique hosts and users, event trends over time, and breakdowns by action, and network direction. It surfaces top threats, triggered rules, active users and hosts, involved files, and the geographic origin of source activity. Use the controls above to filter by action, category, host, and user. Together, these panels support security monitoring, threat investigation, and auditing.
